messages.subject: Re: CODEX2 weird behavior
messages.body_plain:
There’s no bug. The exonic targets you have are overlapping. They should not.

Yuchao

ref=ranges(ref_qc[seqnames(ref_qc)=='chr14'])
countOverlaps(ref,ref)

> MM_copynumbers.csv - resulting copynumbers
